ndjson.label: SESSION SURVIVES THE SWITCH: the post-switch sol turns did not die (200 directly, or 400 recovered by the reactive strip).
POST-SWITCH TURN COMPLETES: the final sol turn delivered the exact terminal text.

wire.label: CONTROL (anti-vacuous pin): a pre-switch qwen request carried a reasoning INPUT item — real foreign reasoning (id+content on the lenient row) exists to cross the model boundary. Without this, the strip/acceptance pins are vacuous (the model produced no reasoning to project).
XWFIX INVARIANT 2 (0 tolerance): NO foreign encrypted_content survives into ANY post-switch sol request — the strip path (D-ENC, prov:176-199) must catch every boundary-marker item.

NO RETRY STORM (tolerant discriminator): 1 sol request = the preemptive model-bound strip sufficed (200, zero reactive involvement); 2 = the 400 fired once and the .58 reactive strip recovered (200); >=3 = same-payload retry storm or strip loop = defect (S3).
